patch.summary: PagerDuty cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: PagerDuty pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Trial/free path present in researched plans

blocks.title: PagerDuty plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: incident management, change and problem management, infrastructure monitoring · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Professional
lines.description: Trial available · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.description: Trial available · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.heading: PagerDuty cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price PagerDuty against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (enterprise security and SSO (Free, Professional, Business, Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (incident management, change and problem management, infrastructure monitoring) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Does not replace Datadog/New Relic telemetry — it pages people. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when SRE/IT teams that need on-call schedules and paging requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
